title: Practicing music
topic: They are talking about piano practice. Where will the woman practice today?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: ピアノの練習について話しています。女の人は、今日はどこで練習しますか。
turns.translation: They are talking about piano practice. Where will the woman practice today?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 今日は家でピアノを弾けません。弟が試験の勉強をしていて、静かにしてほしいと言われました。
turns.translation: I can't play the piano at home today. My younger brother is studying for an exam and asked me to keep quiet.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 学校の音楽室はどうですか。あそこには、いいピアノがありますよ。
turns.translation: How about the music room at school? There's a good piano there.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 今日は合唱の練習で、五時まで使っています。私は四時までしか時間がありません。
turns.translation: It's being used for choir practice until five today. I only have time until four.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 駅の近くの会館にも電話しましたが、今日は空いている部屋がありませんでした。
turns.translation: I called the hall near the station too, but no rooms were available today.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: それなら、うちに来ませんか。姉のピアノがあります。午後は誰も使いません。
turns.translation: In that case, would you like to come to my house? My older sister has a piano. No one uses it in the afternoon.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: いいんですか。ありがとうございます。では、二時にそちらに行きます。楽譜を持って行きますね。
turns.translation: May I? Thank you. Then I'll come to your house at two. I'll bring my sheet music.

options.label: 女の人の家
options.rationale: Her brother needs quiet to study there.

options.label: 学校の音楽室
options.rationale: It remains occupied until after her available time.

options.label: 駅の近くの会館
options.rationale: She has checked, and no rooms are available today.

options.label: 男の人の家
options.rationale: She accepts his final invitation and says she will come there at two.

explanation: The first three places are considered but unavailable for specific reasons. そちら in her reply refers to the man's offered home.
